results.answer: Sreehari worked as an AI Intern at ISMO Bio‑Photonics Pvt. Ltd. in Chennai from August 2024 to November 2024. results.question: Tell me about his traffic signal project.
results.answer: Sreehari built an Intelligent Traffic Signal Control prototype that uses computer‑vision to count vehicles per lane from live video. The system dynamically adjusts traffic‑signal timing, giving priority to high‑volume lanes while still guaranteeing a minimum wait time for every lane. It was developed with YOLO, OpenCV and Python and achieved 98% vehicle‑detection accuracy in controlled tests.

results.question: How does his currency authentication project work?
results.answer: Sreehari’s Currency Authentication project uses computer‑vision techniques to verify Indian banknotes. It extracts ORB keypoints from an image of a note and compares the detected security features with reference patterns using the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). By matching these features, the system can identify authentic notes with about 94 % detection accuracy and can also be extended to verify other documents and IDs.
